# [EPIC] Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service

## Epic

AI-powered recommendations, chat, and semantic search over Filmpire's own movie catalog, plus self-hosted voice control — all backed by a local Ollama model, no third-party AI vendor. A media service for user-uploaded assets (MinIO + MongoDB) rounds out the epic but hasn't been started yet. Per `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.7-3.8.

## Business Value

Shows AI-native product features and object-storage patterns running end-to-end without a paid API dependency — a stronger technical-interview showcase than a pure TMDB proxy.

## Product Goal alignment

Serves the Product Goal's "$0 real cost, production-grade practice" bar (`docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md`, ADR-004) — Ollama and self-hosted Vosk keep this epic's entire AI surface off any paid API.

## Notes

- #93 (AI service) closed: recommendations/chat/semantic search, voice control, and live verification against the real stack (#48) are all done.
- #94 (Media service) and #95 (Playwright E2E) haven't started — both still in the Product Backlog, no Sprint yet.
- Epic closes once all three Stories close.
